addition.item: Adds configurable calendar accent-color sources: H1-H6, navigation, links, or a custom color.
Adds automatic contrasting foreground color for calendar controls.

change.item: Derives the calendar accent color from the selected visible template element.
Falls back to H1 and then Bootstrap Primary when the selected template element is unavailable.

fix.item: Calendar controls no longer remain blue on templates that do not expose their actual visual accent through Bootstrap's standard Primary variable.

note.item: Version 1.2.0 was used during internal development and testing but was not published as a separate public release. Its completed changes were incorporated into version 1.3.0.
Existing calendar appearance settings, language settings, categories, articles and saved dates are preserved.

addition.item: Adds a compact monthly calendar inside a collapsible Date control.
Marks dates with available published articles and highlights the selected date and today.
Adds configurable calendar background opacity, overall size and bold text.
Adds a compact Aa control for visitor-selected calendar size and bold text.
Stores visitor appearance preferences locally in the browser and provides a Reset action.
Adds a translated visual tooltip for the Aa control.

change.item: Replaces the day and month dropdown lists and the Show button.
Preserves the open or closed calendar state while navigating between dates.
Loads calendar data and appearance settings without reusing stale browser or Joomla page-cache responses.
Closes the Aa appearance panel when the visitor clicks outside it.

note.item: Existing date links, language switching, articles, JComments integration, navigation and saved settings are preserved.

addition.item: Adds configurable primary and optional secondary Joomla content languages.
Supports any two installed content languages instead of fixed Russian and English settings.
Supports single-language sites by leaving the secondary language and category empty.

change.item: Migrates existing 1.0.0 Russian and English settings automatically to the new language slots during update.

note.item: Existing categories, compact-module link targets, the date field, category assignments and saved date values are preserved during migration.
English and Russian remain available as administrator and site interface translations; they are no longer hard-coded content-language requirements.

change.item: Promotes the fully tested alpha7 build to the first stable BSL Daily Content release.

note.item: Verified clean installation, in-place update, multilingual full pages and compact modules, and migration from BSL Daily Reflections without loss of saved dates.

addition.item: Automatically opens the Daily Content tab when an article is assigned to a configured daily-content category.

note.item: The behavior applies whenever the category is changed in the article editor, not only when a new article is created.

change.item: Renames the optional menu-item settings as compact-module link targets.
Changes the English compact-module link text from Read more to Read full entry.
Clarifies the plugin description and installation guidance.

note.item: Internal parameter names remain unchanged so existing alpha5 settings are preserved during update.

change.item: Retains Joomla's standard article-editor appearance instead of adding extension-specific administrator tab styling.

note.item: Duplicate-date validation, migration, shortcodes, and content rendering are unchanged.

fix.item: Applies the soft green Daily Content tab background reliably after Joomla renders the custom fields dynamically.

addition.item: Prevents duplicate DD-MM dates within the same configured category.
Adds a soft green background to the Daily Content field tab in the article editor.
Imports empty settings safely from an installed BSL Daily Reflections plugin without changing the date field or saved values.

note.item: The legacy plugin remains installed and enabled during migration verification.
Legacy shortcodes must be replaced before the legacy plugin is disabled.

fix.item: Added an explicit Select option to both category settings to prevent automatic Uncategorised selection.

addition.item: Automatic setup of the required bsl-daily-date custom field.
Full-page {bsldailycontent} shortcode with date navigation and multilingual article lookup.
Server-rendered {bsldailycontenttoday} shortcode for Today in... Custom modules.
Optional language-specific Read more targets selected from published Joomla menu items.
English and Russian interface strings.

note.item: No code is required inside the Custom module beyond the shortcode.
This alpha release starts the BSL Daily Content product line.
